card.name: Linking words before a named drug
card.fires_on: Short linking words (using, by, as, to, of, other, the) in drug-interaction or warning text, right before a specific drug or drug class is named.

modes.label: Verb or preposition before a drug
modes.description: Words like using, by, or to that sit just before a named drug.

modes.label: Such as / of / other before drug list
modes.description: Linking words that introduce an example drug or class.
modes.example: Uricosuric drugs, such<< as>> probenecid and sulfinpy

modes.label: Effect of or class of
modes.description: The words of or the before a drug or chemical class name.
modes.example: may decrease the effectiveness<< of>> methenamine .

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a specific drug name is given in an interaction or warning sentence.
